API key for sending a usage event using `@remotion/licensing`.

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#apikey) (deprecated)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#apikey) (deprecated)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#apikey) (deprecated)
